title: Datasheet for accepted dataset #3 (open GEO series)
context: Third end-to-end datasheet, for an open GEO series. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on the pilot pipeline and triage; only open GEO series (no controlled or identifiable content) are eligible.
objective: Produce a complete, gate-passed, provenance-backed datasheet for an open GEO series and get it accepted (or submitted with the blocker surfaced).
acceptanceCriteria: Dataset is an open GEO series confirmed open-access (no controlled-access or individual-level/germline content) with license/terms cited; passed gate-004 with the artifact committed.
Complete data dictionary, access-tier + identifiability assessment, Datasheet, and valid Croissant produced; every assertion carries a provenance citation; completeness >= 90/100.
Provenance + license snapshot recorded (committed copy + SHA-256 + Wayback URL), including the required GEO/series citation.
Documentation accepted via the GEO/NCBI submitter or curator channel with the acceptance artifact (outcomes/<dataset-id>.json) recorded -- or submitted with the blocker surfaced.
